elsewhere.note: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took…
but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, each man to sharpen his own plowshare, mattock, ax, and sickle.
They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
Its sound will go like the serpent; for they will march with an army, and come against her with axes, as wood cutters.
